# Istituto Marangoni

> > Istituto Marangoni is a prestigious international fashion, design, and art school with campuses in Milano, Firenze, Paris, London, Dubai, and Riyadh, offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs.

Founded over 90 years ago, Istituto Marangoni educates the next generation of fashion designers, stylists, and creative professionals through partnerships with leading brands like Missoni, Coperni, and Camera Nazionale della Moda Italiana. The institution combines traditional craftsmanship with emerging technologies including AI integration.

## Key Topics

- Fashion Design Education
- International Campuses (Milano, Paris, London, Firenze, Dubai, Riyadh)
- Undergraduate & Postgraduate Programs
- Scholarship Opportunities
- Fashion Technology & AI
- Industry Partnerships (Missoni, Coperni, Vogue Business)
- IELTS & CEFR Language Requirements
- UCAS Applications
- Camera Nazionale della Moda Italiana
- Design Courses & Knitwear Innovation
- Fashion Week Events
- Brand Mentorship Programs
- Blackboard Learning Management System
- 90th Anniversary Heritage

- [المنح الدراسية - معهد مارانجوني، مدرسة الموضة والأزياء، والفنون، والتصميم](https://www.istitutomarangoni.com/ar/admission/scholarships): Scholarship programs for undergraduate & postgraduate fashion courses
- [Talent Contest In Partnership With Missoni](https://www.istitutomarangoni.com/ar/admission/scholarships/talent-contest-in-partnership-with-missoni): Missoni scholarship for Fashion Design Knitwear Innovation master's program
